name: Unlucky
description: Fate seems to conspire against them. Higher injury chance.

name: Dao Insight
description: Possesses an innate understanding of the Dao. Faster breakthroughs.

name: Bloodthirsty
description: Revels in combat. Strong in battle, weak in diplomacy.

name: Iron Body
description: A constitution forged in hardship. Resists injury.

name: Wanderer's Heart
description: Drawn to the unknown. Excels on expeditions.

name: Cursed Fate
description: Born under a dark star. Breakthroughs are perilous.

name: Lazy
description: Prefers leisure over labor. Slower work speed.

name: Workaholic
description: Lives to work. Fast worker but neglects cultivation.

name: Charismatic
description: A natural leader. Excels in diplomacy.

name: Survivor
description: Blessed by fate to endure. Cannot die from breakthroughs or missions, only suffer setbacks.
